preconditions.description: Number of cities is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of roads is between 1 and 200,000.
Bash's city is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two different cities with a positive length.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(unhappy_friends_after_destroying_city(c) for c in range(1, n + 1) if c != s)
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of unhappy friends after destroying exactly one city.
